name: autof
description: FB Group Keyword Radar - Monorepo Runner

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); console.log('\x1b[36m%s\x1b[0m', '🚀 Đang khởi chạy đồng thời Backend (port 3001) và Frontend (port 3000)...'); const b = spawn('npm run dev', { cwd: 'backend', shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' }); const f = spawn('npm run dev', { cwd: 'frontend', shell: true, stdio: 'inherit' }); ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM'].forEach(sig => process.on(sig, () => { try { b.kill(); } catch(e){} try { f.kill(); } catch(e){} process.exit(); }));"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps
